_note: Wheelbase, track and stock tire OD match the model blocks in vehicles.js (published OEM spec sheet figures; estimates until a tape confirms them). bodyWidthIn is the published overall width without mirrors and only sizes the stand-in body. source is relative to configurator/public/models/. bodyTrackIn, where present, overrides trackIn for hub placement only.

f250-crew._note: 2017-2022 F-250 crew cab 6.75 ft bed, SRW. Stock LT275/70R18 is about 33.2 in OD. Built by prepare-f250.py from the F-450 source (same cab, hood, doors and front fenders): a 16.4 in slice of the bed is cut out and the dually flares are flattened into the bed side. See configurator/public/models/LICENSES.md

f150-crew._note: 2021+ F-150 SuperCrew 5.5 ft bed. Stock 275/60R20 is about 31.8 in OD. Source is the 2024 Raptor R wide body on 37s (73.7 in track), scaled uniformly to this wheelbase and lowered to the platform stock tire by prepare-f150.py; see configurator/public/models/LICENSES.md bodyTrackIn is the Raptor R's own track, used only to place the hub empties so a wheel pokes past the Raptor flare by the amount the fitment maths (trackIn) says it pokes past a stock fender.

f450-crew._note: 2017-2022 F-450 crew cab 8 ft bed, DRW. Factory LT225/70R19.5 is 31.9 in OD. Source model is real scale; see configurator/public/models/LICENSES.md

gm2500-crew._note: 2020+ Silverado 2500HD crew cab, standard bed, SRW. Stock LT275/70R18 is about 33.2 in OD. Source is the 2015-2019 body, scaled uniformly to this wheelbase; see configurator/public/models/LICENSES.md

gmc2500-crew._note: 2020+ Sierra 2500HD crew cab, standard bed, SRW. Same dims as the Silverado HD. Source scaled uniformly to this wheelbase; see configurator/public/models/LICENSES.md

ram1500-crew._note: 2019+ RAM 1500 (DT) crew cab, 5.7 ft bed. Stock 275/65R20 is about 34.1 in OD. Source is the TRX wide body on 35s, lowered to the platform stock tire; see configurator/public/models/LICENSES.md
